name: The Holy Nation
description: A vast theocracy of humans, ruled by a Phoenix believed to be the reborn first ruler, and said to be over five thousand years old. Its people are zealous farmers who worship Okran, the god of light, and live by the Holy Flame. They hate Skeletons as agents of Narko, the goddess of darkness, and take anyone with robotic limbs for a Skeleton in disguise. They hold Shek and Hivers in contempt, keep women subservient while men serve as its warriors and priests, and send prisoners to labor at Rebirth. Holy Sentinels and Paladins in heavy plate armor fight for it, and it overwhelms its foes with numbers and zeal.
